title: Signal Not Noise
style: industrial electronic, 126 BPM, spoken word verses, punchy staccato delivery, heavy bass drops, glitch production, data theme, tech dystopia, cinematic build to drop, chantable hook, male vocal close-mic dry, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — spoken, no music]
Everything is data.
Not everything is signal.
Know the difference.

[VERSE 1]
Hundred pings a second
Most of them are noise
Correlation isn't causation
Stop mistaking heat for voice

Pattern in the chaos
Or chaos in the pattern
Can't tell the difference
When the algorithm's flattened

[PRE-CHORUS]
Signal — or noise?
Real — or just boys?
Cut — through — the noise
Signal — your voice

[DROP]
Signal not noise — signal not noise
Cut through the data — signal not noise
Human in the loop — signal not noise
You are the filter — signal not noise

[VERSE 2]
Log it or lose it
Every incident counts
The noise will distract you
Signal — that's the amount

Thirty-six seconds
To decide what's real
Log before emotion
Facts before the feel

[FINAL DROP]
Signal not noise — signal not noise
Data not drama — signal not noise
Log it right — signal not noise
Human in the loop — signal not noise

[OUTRO — spoken]
The signal was always there.
You just had to stop listening to the noise.
